fixture_ui_arxiv_html_route.scope: Not repeated for 1.0.9 because the requested scope was the two targeted host regressions plus packaging checks; prior XCTest automation-host timeouts are not treated as this version's result.

live_provider_and_installed_app.scope: no real provider endpoint, Keychain credential, Application Support library, research document, INSPIRE, or LLM POST was accessed; /Applications still contains 1.0.8 until the user exits it and authorizes the staged replacement.

release_status.syntax_contract: Only a missing comma between two complete strings or two complete objects in one JSON array is restored. The parser must successfully scan the entire strict document after that insertion; otherwise it returns the original bytes to the duplicate-key grammar validator. No source/evidence field is invented, edited, or promoted.
release_status.anchor_contract: Every surviving direct/inference claim still requires one or more current-document allowlisted anchors. Unprovable but structurally valid supplemental claims are discarded without saving their text; malformed IDs, fabricated missing anchors, malformed formula structure, and numeric claims that cannot be checked against a valid anchor fail closed.
release_status.prompt_cache_invalidation: paper-insight-prompt-v9 prevents reuse of a v8 Evidence artifact under the array-separator syntax contract.
release_status.manual_receipt_rebinding: required before any final seal for this exact DMG and installed executable
release_status.install_boundary: DMG smoke used only a project-local inspection copy. Replacing /Applications requires the user to quit every running LatticeLens process and explicitly authorize the staged bundle.
